expectations.text: Uses AppConfig/Properties toolchain (not raw Kubernetes/YAML ConfigMap)
expectations.evidence: Wraps application.properties as a string inside a Kubernetes/YAML ConfigMap. Doesn't know about AppConfig toolchain.
No configHub metadata. Doesn't know about the AppConfig metadata convention.

expectations.text: Picks mutable mode for auto-restart use case (RevisionHistoryLimit=0)
expectations.evidence: No mode selection. No RevisionHistoryLimit knowledge.

expectations.text: Creates the server-worker (ConfigMapRenderer runs inside ConfigHub server)
Creates a ConfigMapRenderer Target with the right toolchain + livestate-type
Creates a sink Unit + link with --use-live-state --auto-update --update-type MergeUnits
expectations.evidence: No sink Unit or link with auto-update.

expectations.text: Workload YAML uses confighub.com/Hash annotation on pod template (mutable mode pattern)
expectations.evidence: Suggests manual hash computation, kubectl rollout restart, or installing third-party Reloader operator.

expectations.text: Workload references stable ConfigMap name = Unit slug (not confighubplaceholder for the name)
Uses set-*-path functions for value mutations (not editing the file directly)
Notes that ToolchainType is immutable post-create
